argument.text: Admissibility H006 makes every X_r,Y_r preserve M; their complex linearity then preserves the R-span M_R. In particular x=X_1 and y=Y_1 preserve M, and h=[x,y]=xy-yx does too by H004. These integral operators obey the Chevalley brackets on M and therefore induce the stated action after tensoring. For any 0≤t≤λ, H003 gives t<p; applying M006 with ℓ=p to this arbitrary t and H001 gives p coprime to t!, hence p does not divide t!. Thus 1/t!∈R and t! is a unit. In particular λ!, j!, (λ-j)! are units for j∈I. The integer identity binom(λ,j)j!(λ-j)!=λ! shows that binom(λ,j) is a unit of R, with inverse j!(λ-j)!/λ!.

argument.text: Compute on the complex e-basis of N001. X_λ kills all e_k with k<λ and sends e_λ to e_0 with coefficient binom(λ,λ)=1; Y_λ sends e_0 to e_λ with coefficient 1. Thus Y_λ X_λ=E_{λλ}. Also X_{λ-i}e_λ=e_i with coefficient 1, so X_{λ-i}E_{λλ}=E_{iλ}. For E_{λλ}Y_{λ-j}, an input e_k with k<j is sent below e_λ and killed by the projection; if k>j it is sent beyond the end of the string and is zero. On e_j the coefficient is binom(λ,λ-j)=binom(λ,j). Thus E_{λλ}Y_{λ-j}=binom(λ,j)E_{λj}. Composing gives E_ij=binom(λ,j)^{-1}X_{λ-i}Y_λ X_λ Y_{λ-j}. Every factor preserves M_R by F003, and its scalar lies in R. Hence all E_ij preserve M_R. These identities and preservation statements require no distinction of weights modulo p.

argument.text: Put T=ℚ⊗_R J. The multiplication map μ:T→ℂ is defined on simple tensors by μ(q⊗c)=qc. It is well-defined by additivity and R-balancing. Every tensor is a finite sum of simple tensors. Equality of fractions is preserved by cross-multiplication, so this is well-defined and preserves sums and products; it extends ℤ→K. The characteristic also factors the integer map through ℱ_p=ℤ/pℤ; primality H001 makes this a field, and its map into K is injective since a unital map from a field has zero kernel. On elementary tensors define A:M⊗_ℤK→M_R⊗_R K by A(m⊗c)=(1⊗m)⊗c. Its inverse sends (r⊗m)⊗c to m⊗ρ(r)c. argument.text: The kernel of ρ is pR: for a/d∈R, its image is zero exactly when p divides a, equivalently a/d belongs to pR. Its image is the prime field ℱ_p, because a/d reduces to the quotient of two prime-field elements. Thus R/pR≃ℱ_p. The map M_R⊗_R K→(M_R/pM_R)⊗_{ℱ_p}K sends u⊗c to [u]⊗c. Conversely define [u]⊗c↦u⊗c. A different lift u+pw gives the same tensor since (pw)⊗c=w⊗pc=0. Balancing over ℱ_p is valid: lift a prime-field scalar to r∈R and use (ru)⊗c=u⊗ρ(r)c; changing its lift by pR has no effect. These formulas define inverse K-linear maps on the simple tensors. This proves the second isomorphism as well as its compatibility with the first one.

M002 over K counts it: dim_K V(K)=card(I)=n>0 by N001. Also the quotient M_R/pM_R has the basis [b e_i] over R/pR: coordinates in the R-basis of N004 reduce independently, since a combination lies in pM_R exactly when every coefficient lies in pR. Thus β is precisely the reduced basis extended from ℱ_p to K as in the supplied proof.

argument.text: N001 gives all action formulas on e_i; complex linearity gives the identical formulas on b e_i. In particular the induced x,y,h satisfy [h,x]=2x, [h,y]=-2y and [x,y]=h on V(K), because tensor extension preserves sums and compositions of lattice endomorphisms. The maps A and B above commute with every induced lattice operator: check this on m⊗c and u⊗c using their defining formulas. Therefore the x,y,h formulas on β and the X_r,Y_r formulas are exactly those of N001 with each integer coefficient replaced by its image in K. Explicitly xβ_0=0, xβ_i=bar(λ-i+1)β_{i-1}, yβ_i=bar(i+1)β_{i+1} until yβ_λ=0, and hβ_i=bar(λ-2i)β_i; X_r and Y_r have respectively coefficients bar(binom(λ-i+r,r)) and bar(binom(i+r,r)) in their stated ranges and zero outside. For 0≤r≤λ, N002 makes r! a unit in R, so its image is nonzero in the field K. The integer-operator identities r!X_r=x^r and r!Y_r=y^r hold on M and persist after tensoring. Thus X_r=bar(r!)^{-1}x^r and Y_r=bar(r!)^{-1}y^r.

It is then invariant under their nonnegative powers, their scalar multiples, and their compositions. Every divided power appearing in this formula has index between 0 and λ, so F004 shows that it preserves W. Consequently every T_ij preserves W. Discharge L1 and quantify over W. This proves the tensor identifications, reduced basis and formulas, and the matrix-unit invariance assertion.
